title: Register states for the logarithmic program
statement: A register state is a tuple of fifteen natural numbers, denoted $p,n,a,b,cur,t,tmp,st,nx,q,L,u,w,e,f$, representing respectively the input pointer, vertex count, outer counter, inner counter, current vertex, target, scratch copy, step count, random index, saved field position, walk length, candidate vertex, column, scratch sum, and scratch product.
